map.选择 User-agent、Allow、Disallow 与 Sitemap，快: Choose User-agent, Allow, Disallow, and Sitemap to quickly generate robots.txt.
map.生成控制爬虫抓取范围的 robots.txt。: Generate a robots.txt that controls crawler scope.
map.：User-agent 指定目标爬虫，Disallow/Allow 控制路径，C: : User-agent targets a crawler; Disallow/Allow control paths; Crawl-delay throttles; Sitemap declares the sitemap URL.
map.结束锚定（后者为广泛支持的扩展）。: end anchors (the latter is a widely supported extension).
map.为全站禁止；值为空则表示全部允许。: means disallow the entire site; an empty value means allow all.
map.：robots.txt 属君子协定，无法阻止恶意爬虫；敏感内容必须做鉴权。: : robots.txt is a gentlemen's agreement and cannot stop malicious crawlers; sensitive content must be authenticated.
map.每个规则组可添加多个 User-agent 与路径规则。: Each rule group can have multiple User-agents and path rules.
map.文本直接生成，可用于网站根目录放置。: Text is generated directly and can be placed at the site root.
map.新站上线前配置抓取规则：屏蔽后台、搜索结果页与接口路径，避免爬虫把无价值页面抓满: Configure crawl rules before a new site goes live: block the admin, search-results, and API paths to keep crawlers from wasting quota on worthless pages.
map.不能，仅建议，敏感路径仍需鉴权。: No, it is only advisory; sensitive paths still need authentication.
map.为什么屏蔽了还是被搜到？: Why is a blocked page still indexed?
map.因为 robots.txt 只规范「抓取」，不禁止「索引」：若有外部链接指向该页: Because robots.txt only governs "crawling," not "indexing": if an external link points to the page, search engines may still index it (shown as a "not crawled" result). To truly avoid indexing, use a noindex response header or meta tag; for sensitive content you must require login authentication—robots.txt can even expose the path.
